periods.label: 同为妹妹的理解

status.current: supports Ikki in Osaka and later consoles Koume Moroboshi during Ikki's first-round duel

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she anxiously watches his strange freezing symptoms during the duel.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Roommate and friend who helps her dress and accompany Ikki around Osaka.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend/rival; worries that Stella's last-minute training may overtax her.
relationships.koume-moroboshi: Understands Koume as another sister watching a brother suffer and tells her siblings are allowed to rely on elder brothers.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Potential D-block opponent and superior water specialist whom Shizuku respects warily.

periods.summary: Shizuku attends the pre-tournament banquet in formal dress, worries over Stella's intense training, and nearly attacks Sara for molesting Ikki. At the banquet she is targeted by Yui Tatara's poisoned food, but Ikki detects the trap. During the Moroboshi fight she learns Moroboshi's painful history from Kiriko Yakushi and later follows Koume when Koume flees the stands. Shizuku tells Koume that younger sisters are permitted to rely on and cheer for their elder brothers, helping Koume finally shout support for Yuudai.

key_events.summary: Is protected from Tatara's poisoned food and witnesses Akatsuki's hostility.
Learns why Moroboshi fights for Koume.
Consoles Koume and helps her return to cheer for her brother.

periods.time: Seven Stars first and second rounds
periods.label: 深海魔女准备迎击厄运

status.current: wins her D-block first-round match without injury and prepares to face Amane in the third round

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to the point of blunt hostility toward his threats, yet calm and analytical enough to claim she has a countermeasure for Amane.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; she shields him verbally and physically from Amane and worries about his forced double matches.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival/sister-in-law figure; she criticizes Stella's recklessness but later accepts her place in Ikki's path.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Enemy she detests for clinging to Ikki and whose ability she claims she can counter before he reaches Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who tells Ikki Shizuku likely has a real plan against Amane.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Potential D-block competitor removed by Amane's hospital crisis.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Stella's match with mounting frustration, then learns from Ikki's group that Brute Dragon Roar would be extremely dangerous for water/body-based methods. When Amane appears and clings to Ikki, Shizuku kicks him away and states plainly that Ikki finds him disgusting, refusing to let Amane exploit Ikki's kindness. After Kiriko's forced withdrawal and Amane's true ability reveal, Shizuku recognizes the threat but later states she has found a way to defeat Excessive Goddess's Favor. She wins her own D-block first-round match flawlessly, keeping Hagun's perfect first-round record and setting up her confrontation with Amane before Ikki would have to face him.

key_events.summary: Protects Ikki during Amane's reveal and rejects his apology.
Wins her first-round D-block match without injury.
Suspects with Ikki that Amane may have worsened the tournament schedule.

periods.time: Selection-battle side episodes around Ikki's rise
periods.label: 妹妹的恋慕、退让与不退让
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Kurogane family by birth

status.emotional_state: knows Ikki chose Stella but cannot abandon her own love
status.stance: tests and challenges Stella rather than withdrawing completely

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to a frightening degree, sharp-tongued toward Stella, but fundamentally willing to suffer if it helps Ikki's happiness.
personality.inner_conflict: She wants Ikki's happiness more than her own, but cannot simply discard romantic love for him.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and emotional center; she wants to be the one who makes him happiest.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival; she eventually sees why Ikki likes Stella but refuses to formally concede.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Roommate and confidant who takes her drinking and validates her right to keep loving Ikki.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: News club narrator who later recounts Shizuku's hidden struggle.

periods.summary: Vol-08 reveals Shizuku's interior conflict more directly. On the night Ikki defeats Kirihara, Alice takes her to a bar; drunk, she recounts Ikki's kindness, then admits Stella may be better able to make him happy. Alice tells her she need not discard her love, and that any woman who cannot overcome Shizuku has no right to take Ikki. Later, after Ikki and Stella's relationship becomes public, Shizuku collapses into a messy, game-playing depression. Alice reminds her she can still act as Ikki's family, so she tests Stella's domestic skill and sincerity. Stella passes, and Shizuku says 'please take care of my brother,' but Stella later pretends the test failed so Shizuku need not force herself to relinquish the rivalry.

key_events.summary: Drinks for the first time with Alice and confronts whether she should step aside for Stella.
Tests Stella's right to be Ikki's partner through cleaning, cooking and a direct love question.

periods.time: Second-day D-block second round through scheduled third-round match
periods.label: 深海魔女晋级后被天音血祭

status.current: defeats Momiji Asagi in round two but is later found impaled in the waiting room before her match with Amane
status.condition: physically victorious over Momiji; later critical and bloodied on the wall in the broadcast feed
status.secret: claims to have a hidden plan against Amane but it is not revealed before the incident

personality.summary: Calm, strategic and devoted to Ikki, with a sharp mischievous streak toward Stella.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she reassures him about Amane and he looks forward to fighting her in the semifinal if she wins.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Closest friend and support; she asks Alice to help with her pre-match preparation and he disappears from the stands when her match time comes.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival sister-in-law; she tricks Stella into a bunny outfit but also shows affection by treating teasing Stella as her privilege.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Second-round opponent; Shizuku defeats Momiji by reading her movement through a hidden water film.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Third-round opponent; she intends to counter him but is shown crucified by thin swords before their public match begins.

periods.summary: Shizuku wins her second-round match against last year's third-place fighter Momiji Asagi. Unable to follow Momiji's Nukiachi visually, she secretly spreads a thin water membrane across the arena and reads ripples to block Momiji's rear attack, then finishes her with Water Prison Orb. She joins Ikki, Stella, Alice and Sara for the shopping interlude despite having a match later, claiming she has a hidden plan for Amane. In the department store she buys a blue-and-white iris yukata, shows her knowledge of formal Japanese dress, and tricks Stella into wearing a bunny girl outfit. Her teasing carries a strange affection that Ikki notices. Before the third-round match against Amane, Shizuku leaves with Alice for final preparations. When the broadcast switches to the waiting room, she is shown bloodied and pierced by many thin swords, pinned to the wall while Amane laughs, setting up Ikki's nightmare semifinal.

key_events.summary: Defeats Momiji by sensing her through water spread across the arena.
Participates in the shopping interlude and tricks Stella with the bunny outfit.
Is found impaled in the waiting room before the scheduled D-block third-round match.

periods.time: Seven Stars semifinal eve through delayed final approval
periods.label: 为兄长不惜弃赛的深海魔女
titles: 七星剑武祭第三轮败退者

status.current: recovers from Amane's backstage attack and watches Ikki reach the final
status.tournament: disqualified for attacking Amane before their match; later suspended from public matches for three months
status.emotional_state: ashamed of failing to protect Ikki, then reassured by Ikki and Stella

personality.summary: Fiercely devoted to Ikki and willing to sacrifice her tournament place, school life, and reputation to protect him.
fears: watching Ikki be destroyed by Amane
having her love twisted before Ikki
values: stand beside Alice and Stella despite rivalry

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she attacks Amane to keep him away from Ikki and later receives Ikki's thanks and pride.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Trusted partner in the ambush; he chooses to stay with her rather than leave her alone.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Scheduled third-round opponent and hated threat; his causality ability defeats and humiliates her.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival and future sister-in-law; Stella saves her dignity by silencing Amane and later banters with her to show she is recovering.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father present during Ikki's emergency; his practical warning stops her from a useless revenge attempt.

periods.summary: Shizuku recalls how she once failed to see the shadows around Ikki's childhood and vows she will now lose anything for him. Before her match with Amane, she tells Alice her plan: deliberately commit a pre-match attack so Amane's causality will allow the forbidden route, then injure him badly enough to keep him from the semifinal. With Alice's Shadow Walk she pierces Amane with ice, but his absurd luck lets him survive, disable Alice, and turn the duel into a one-minute wager. Shizuku counters his forced mistakes with area fire, but Amane's protection nullifies the attack, pins her to the wall, and publicly twists her love for Ikki until Stella breaks in and stops him. She is disqualified rather than expelled. Later she apologizes to Ikki, who embraces her and says she fought for both him and the dignity of the festival. After Ikki defeats Amane, she rushes to congratulate him, discovers his breathing has stopped, and endures the emergency wait until Kiriko saves him. She then joins the crowd awaiting the delayed final.

key_events.summary: Frames her decision to protect Ikki even at total personal cost.
Ambushes Amane with Alice, is defeated and humiliated by causality.
Is rescued by Stella when Amane tries to expose and distort her feelings.
Receives Ikki's gratitude instead of condemnation before he faces Amane.
Waits in panic while Ikki is saved from the death effect.
